title: TCL 75" C7L Premium SQD-Mini LED $1818 (via Price Check) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: TCL 75" C7L Premium SQD-Mini LED $1818 (via Price Check) @ The Good Guys

[InLaymansTerms] Damn, thats a good price, I recently posted a review on my YT channel of this TV, its a cracker, highly recommend for those kind of dollars.
[InLaymansTerms] By OzB rules, im not permitted to share or link to any of my content. Just search my username or for TCL C8L Review on YouTube.
[woonz] you reviewed the C8L, obviously better but C7L is still good as well based on other reviews.
[jordybargains] $1800 on appliance central with free delivery.
Side note: Just got the 75c6l for $1390 free delivery.
Use coupon code “SAVENOW” for $20 discount to get above prices.
[descavenger] Good spot, however I can't any specs on this c6l regarding it's dimming zones etc
[chasingstoke] I'm also waiting on a good deal on a high quality 55" tv
[Rated3] That seems pretty good for gaming, right?
[CheapOjoe] Much better then the average TV? definitely
[speedyjonzalas] Before I got it I read reviews and they were mixed, but the more I look back on them, the more it's clear they are written by people expecting unrealistic things. It's like they expect the same experience as an OLED pc gaming monitor which is absurd.
I play Xbox series X, mainly COD black ops 6 at a reasonable level, and it's great.
One thing when you get it though is to review Reddit etc for base settings as they do need adjusted. (Eg removing motion smoothing)
I'm mega happy with it. Great blacks, fantastic picture. I paired it with a sound bar so thats the only area I'm not sure is any good.
[CheapOjoe] Any good deals on the 55 inch C7L version ?
[dbnewman89] lol the AI summary is for the 98 - 53kg for a 75 would be wild :P
[Ghogger] Fantastic TV, got mine for $1600 after returning the soundbar from this deal
